+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""RoboPaint trajectory generator for the Fine Wind, Clear Morning copy task.

+# Rows are in paint01..paint05 order in the left well column, then paint06..10

+SHEET_CX = -0.1
+SHEET_CY = 0.0
+SHEET_Z = 0.020
+CONTACT_Z = 0.012
+AIR_Z = 0.120
+PALETTE_Z = 0.015

+# based on the practice-sheet strokes.  Sampling every 12 rows gives overlap
+# for opaque paint while keeping 383 planned main-sheet contacts.
+ROW_STEP = 12
+MIN_RUN = 48
+STROKE_WIDTH_PX = 32
+END_INSET_PX = STROKE_WIDTH_PX // 2 - 1
+LEADIN_MM = 15.0

+    image = np.asarray(Image.open(TARGET).convert("RGB"), dtype=np.float64)
+    d = np.linalg.norm(image[:, :, None, :] - PAINTS[None, None, :, :], axis=3)
+    nearest_d = d.min(axis=2)
+    labels = d.argmin(axis=2).astype(np.int16)
+    is_paper = np.linalg.norm(image - PAPER_RGB, axis=2) + 5.0 < nearest_d
+    labels = median_filter(labels, size=3)

+    strokes: list[dict] = []
+    for v in range(ROW_STEP // 2, 1024, ROW_STEP):
+        row = labels[v]
+        cuts = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(row[1:] != row[:-1]) + 1, 1024]
